blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 141 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (November 3, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: HLF & CRL lead 141 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 37 Canadian and 104 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of November 3, 2026) found 141 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 37 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 21 of them new to the list this week. High Liner Foods Incorporated (HLF) leads with a +95% six-month return, and Energy is the most represented sector with 15 names.

In the U.S., 104 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 49 of them new to the list this week. Charles River Laboratories International Inc. (CRL) leads with a +94% six-month return, and Health Care is the most represented sector with 26 names.
